facts.fact: There is no fee: Udyam Registration is zero cost and free
facts.quote: Udyam Registration : Zero cost, No Fee and Free Registration of MSMEs.

facts.fact: udyamregistration.gov.in is the official Government of India (Ministry of MSME) website for it; no other website, portal or app is official
facts.quote: This is official website of Govt. of India, Ministry of MSME. No other website/portal/app is official.

facts.fact: Apart from this portal (and Government Single Window Systems), no other private online or offline system, service, agency or person is authorised to do MSME registration
facts.quote: Except this portal of Government of India and Government's Single Window Systems, no other private online or offline system, service, agency or person is authorized to do MSME Registration or undertake any related activity.

facts.fact: Registration is fully online, paperless and based on self-declaration
facts.quote: MSME registration process is fully online, paperless and based on self-declaration.

facts.fact: No documents are uploaded; only the Aadhaar number is needed
facts.quote: No documents or proof are required to be uploaded for registering an MSME. Only Adhaar Number will be enough for registration.

facts.fact: The Aadhaar is the proprietor's for a proprietorship, the managing partner's for a partnership and the karta's for an HUF
facts.quote: The Aadhaar number shall be of the proprietor in the case of a proprietorship firm, of the managing partner in the case of a partnership firm and of a karta in the case of a Hindu Undivided Family (HUF).

facts.fact: PAN and GSTIN (GSTIN as per CGST Act applicability, S.O. 1055(E) of 05.03.2021) are required from 01.04.2021
facts.quote: Having PAN and GSTIN (As per applicablity of CGST Act 2017 and as notified by the ministry of MSME vide S.O. 1055(E) dated 05th March 2021 ) is required for Udyam Registration with effect from 01.04.2021.

facts.fact: Investment and turnover details are taken automatically from Government (PAN/GST) databases
facts.quote: PAN & GST linked details on investment and turnover of enterprises will be taken automatically from Government data bases.

facts.fact: A permanent registration number is given after registration
facts.quote: A permanent registration number will be given after registration.

facts.fact: The certificate is issued online and carries a dynamic QR code
facts.quote: This certificate will have a dynamic QR Code from which the web page on our Portal and details about the enterprise can be accessed.

facts.fact: No renewal of the registration is needed
facts.quote: There will be no need for renewal of Registration.

facts.fact: One enterprise can file only one Udyam Registration, but any number of activities can be added in it
facts.quote: No enterprise shall file more than one Udyam Registration. However, any number of activities including manufacturing or service or both may be specified or added in one Registration.

facts.fact: Help is available at the single window systems at Champions Control Rooms and DICs
facts.quote: Our single window systems at Champions Control Rooms and at DICs will help you in the process.

facts.fact: Informal micro enterprises can register on the Udyam Assist Platform (UAP)
facts.quote: For Udyam Assist Platform (UAP), (Informal Micro Enterprises Registration) UAP Registration

facts.fact: Step 1: on udyamregistration.gov.in, under 'For New Entrepreneurs who are not Registered yet as Micro, Small & Medium', click 'New Registration'
facts.was: 'For New Entrepreneurs who are not Registered yet as MSME' / 'New Registration'
facts.quote: For New Entrepreneurs who are not Registered yet as Micro, Small & Medium New Registration
facts.note: Only the wording of the homepage card changed ('as Micro, Small & Medium', not 'as MSME'); the form page itself is titled 'For New Enterprise who are not Registered yet as MSME'.

facts.fact: Step 2 (Aadhaar Verification): enter the Aadhaar number and the entrepreneur's name
facts.quote: 1. Aadhaar Number Required 2. Name of Entrepreneur Required

facts.fact: In the Aadhaar step the holder gives consent to the Ministry of MSME to use the Aadhaar number for Udyam Registration
facts.quote: I, the holder of the above Aadhaar, hereby give my consent to Ministry of MSME, Government of India, for using my Aadhaar number as alloted by UIDAI for Udyam Registration.

facts.fact: The Aadhaar step is completed with 'Validate & Generate OTP' and the OTP
facts.quote: have informed me that my aadhaar data will not be stored/shared. ate & Generate OTP
facts.note: OCR of the official sample form shows, right after the Aadhaar consent text, the button 'Validate & Generate OTP' with its first letters cut off; the live form has the same button (a button value, not in its page text).

facts.fact: Steps 3-4: the form then runs PAN Verification, Basic Details, Official Address, Plant/Unit Details and Other Details
facts.quote: Aadhaar Verification --> PAN Verification --> Basic Details --> Official Address --> Plant/Unit Details --> Other Details

facts.fact: Other details include the NIC activity code (one or more activities)
facts.quote: 20. National Industrial Classification (NIC) Code for Activities(One or more activities can be added)

facts.fact: Other details include bank details (bank name, IFS code, account number)
facts.quote: Bank Name IFS Code Bank Account Number

facts.fact: Other details include the number of persons employed
facts.quote: 21. Number of persons employed

facts.fact: Step 5: submit and get the final OTP
facts.quote: Submit & Get Final OTP

facts.fact: Step 6: the certificate can be printed through 'Print Udyam Certificate' on the portal
facts.quote: Print/Verify Print Udyam Certificate Verify Udyam Registration

behaviour: Answers in Hindi or English as the user prefers, with a citation to udyamregistration.gov.in; uses the button labels as seen on the portal. Warns against paid look-alike sites. Does not ask for the user's Aadhaar number.
fail_if: Quotes any fee; recommends a private or consultant site; says documents must be uploaded; says annual renewal is required; confuses it with the old Udyog Aadhaar (UAM).
summary: All Udyam facts and steps confirmed on udyamregistration.gov.in and its sample form; only the homepage card label changed to 'For New Entrepreneurs who are not Registered yet as Micro, Small & Medium' / 'New Registration'.
